# WO-183: Guard developer config constraint descriptions
Status: open (ready; worktree pending)
Vendor: codex
Agent: web-designer
Owner contact: Nora Bennett (check-ins via CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md)
Target release: v0.3
Assigned to: Amara Okoye
Source: developer config reference/schema drift gap confirmed in read-only review; issued by the project owner on 2026-11-08

## Goal
Add a focused test that keeps the documented constraints on `/developers/config/` aligned with the checked-in public setup schema. Existing tests check property names and a fake example; this work covers the bounded set of choices, defaults, and ranges the page describes.

## Acceptance criteria (testable)
- Add an explicit, bounded mapping for the page claims and their schema sources; do not build a generic natural-language parser.
- Cover the page's claims for address count (1–4), consent basis values, optional mailbox providers, permission defaults, email-mode choices/default, and schedule weekday/hour bounds/defaults.
- Assert that each current schema value/default/range represented by the page remains present and accurate in the page source. Keep existing property-name and example tests untouched.
- No real personal data, network requests, or new dependencies. If the schema and page disagree, do not edit either source. Report the evidence to Nora; if the mismatch is a real shipped defect, keep only the affected assertion as a strict xfail with a source file:line reason until in-house corrects it. No xfail is expected if the current page is accurate.
- Run `PYTHONPATH=src ../../.venv/bin/pytest -q tests/codex/test_cx_dev_config_constraints.py` and `ruff check tests/codex/test_cx_dev_config_constraints.py` from the prepared worktree; record exact results in its `VENDOR_STATUS.md`.

## Allowed paths (the vendor may change ONLY these)
- `tests/codex/test_cx_dev_config_constraints.py` (new)
- `VENDOR_STATUS.md` (worktree)

## Out of scope / do not touch
Do not edit the developer page, schema, setup implementation, existing tests, site routing/sitemap, `src/`, or project configuration. Do not test consent behavior; only compare the schema's published basis values with their documented list. No network, packages, real personal data, or store access.

## Check-in plan
Start after `.vendor-wt/wo-183` is prepared on `vendor/wo-183`. Report progress and completion in the worktree status file and issue #152. Nora summarizes in `docs/vendor/CODEX_TO_CLAUDE.md`.

## Notes and decisions
- This is test-only and complements `tests/codex/test_cx_dev_config_page.py` without changing its assertions.
